title: Red Hat Security Advisory: MTV RHEL9 Images
description: A vulnerability in the oras-go file content store component allows a remote attacker to bypass filesystem boundaries via symbolic link traversal. This flaw permits creation of files outside the intended working directory, potentially leading to unauthorized file modification or system compromise depending on the runtime environment. The issue affects the Migration Toolkit for Virtualization (MTV) RHEL9 images. Red Hat has issued advisories and updates addressing this and related issues.
